requirements.title: LOG argument restrictions
requirements.definition: X shall be real or complex; a real X shall be greater than zero, and a complex X shall not be zero.

requirements.title: LOG complex result uses the principal imaginary range
requirements.definition: For a complex LOG result, the principal value has imaginary part in the range -pi through pi.

pending.LOG-complex-principal-imaginary-range: Use X=CMPLX(-1.0,1.0), initialize an imaginary-part sentinel outside the branch interval, compute AIMAG(LOG(X)), and assert the value is positive and no greater than ACOS(-1.0); mutate X to CONJG(X) so the sign-sensitive principal-branch assertion fails. No exact angle value is asserted.
